summary: Craig Faulhaber (41) fell 35 feet to the ground top-rope-soloing Burning Down the Haus (5.13d) when his Petzl Shunt detached from the rope; Summit County Rescue Group responded and he was helicoptered to St. Anthony's with multiple broken bones (L1/L2 vertebrae, heels, elbow, pelvis, sacrum, ribs).
location: Burning Down the Haus, Haus Rock, near Keystone
notes: ANAC 2022 edition (Pub 2022); incident date Sep 19 per article.
